if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432: \n433:     Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434:     val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435:     if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) Octree& octree,\n480:                   RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481:     const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482:     const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483: \n484:     // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485:     if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486: \n487:     val_t kij = ZERO;\n488: \n489:     for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490:         Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491:         Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492: \n493:         if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494: \n495: cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501: \n502:         if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503: \n504:         kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505:     }\n506: \n507: Vec3 {\n    val_t x, y, z;\n\n    constexpr Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}\n    constexpr Vec3(val_t x, val_t y, val_t z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n    explicit constexpr Vec3(val_t v) : x(v), y(v), z(v) ============================================================================\n// Triangle-Box Overlap Test (for octree construction)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\nbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n\n    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n\n    // Test triangle normal\n    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n\n    // Test 9 edge cross products\n    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n            Vec3 crossAxis = ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\nconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n\nclass Octree {\npublic:\n    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = &triangles;\n        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n\n        // Compute bounding box\n        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n        for (const auto& tri :        minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size();      minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\npublic:\n    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n\n        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n    template<typename Func>\n    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n        }\n        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n\n                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Get radiosity from source <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n            }\n\n state.numTimesteps) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// I also want to double check edge cases like more ranks than rows, and I still need to look at the results_output header to understand how it handles output before finalizing this approach.\n\n","time":{"start":1792998519886,"end":1792998613268},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}

// Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n    // Advance the stream by n draws without generating values\n    void skip(unsigned long long n) { rng.discard(n); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// True if the pair is culled (triangles facing the same direction).\n// Culled pairs consume no random numbers.\ninline bool isCulledPair(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    return triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f;\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (isCulledPair(triI, triJ)) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle (replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0) (replicated)\n\n    // Receiver rows [rows.begin, rows.end) owned by this rank.\n    // kij and tau hold only these rows (row-major, rows.count() x N).\n    RowRange rows;\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors for owned rows\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays for owned rows\n    int minTau;                     // Global minimum of tau over all i != j\n\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source (replicated)\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure (replicated)\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t kijIdx(size_t i, size_t j) const { return (i - rows.begin) * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh (replicated on every rank; deterministic)\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Partition receiver rows across ranks\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    state.rows = partitionRows(N, g_rank, g_size);\n    state.kij.assign(state.rows.count() * N, ZERO);\n    state.tau.assign(state.rows.count() * N, 0);\n    state.minTau = INT_MAX;\n\n    // Initialize radiosity and distance arrays\n    state.radE.assign(timesteps * N, ZERO);\n    state.radB.assign(timesteps * N, ZERO);\n    state.distances.assign(N, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const RowRange rows = state.rows;\n\n    // The sequential algorithm draws from one random stream in row-major (i, j)\n    // order, and each non-culled pair consumes a fixed number of draws. Count the\n    // non-culled pairs in the rows owned by each rank, then skip this rank's share\n    // of the stream so every pair receives exactly the random numbers it would\n    // have received in the sequential program.\n    unsigned long long myPairs = 0;\n    for (size_t i = rows.begin; i < rows.end; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            if (!isCulledPair(state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j])) ++myPairs;\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<unsigned long long> pairsPerRank(g_size);\n    MPI_Allgather(&myPairs, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG,\n                  pairsPerRank.data(), 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    unsigned long long pairsBefore = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_rank; ++r) pairsBefore += pairsPerRank[r];\n\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n    rng.skip(pairsBefore * RNG_DRAWS_PER_PAIR);\n\n    const size_t localRows = rows.count();\n    for (size_t i = rows.begin; i < rows.end; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.kij[state.kijIdx(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n        }\n        size_t done = i - rows.begin + 1;\n        if (g_rank == 0 && (done % 100 == 0 || done == localRows)) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", done, localRows);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    int localMin = INT_MAX;\n\n    for (size_t i = state.rows.begin; i < state.rows.end; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            int tij = computeTau(state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n            state.tau[state.kijIdx(i, j)] = tij;\n            localMin = std::min(localMin, tij);\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &state.minTau, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    const RowRange rows = state.rows;\n    const size_t localN = rows.count();\n\n    // Tau is at least 1 for every pair of distinct triangles (distinct centers).\n    // Computing timesteps [t0, t0 + L) requires radiosity only from times\n    // t - tau <= t0 + L - 1 - minTau < t0 whenever L <= minTau. Each block of L\n    // timesteps can therefore be computed locally, then exchanged with a single\n    // collective, instead of one exchange per timestep.\n    if (state.minTau < 1) {\n        if (g_rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"roomsim: invalid zero time delay between distinct triangles\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    const size_t L = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(static_cast<size_t>(state.minTau), T));\n\n    // Per-rank block layout: rank r contributes (Lb * count_r) values at offset Lb * begin_r\n    std::vector<int> counts(g_size), displs(g_size);\n    std::vector<val_t> blockBuf(L * N);\n\n    for (size_t t0 = 0; t0 < T; t0 += L) {\n        const size_t Lb = std::min(L, T - t0);\n\n        for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n            RowRange rr = partitionRows(N, r, g_size);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(Lb * rr.count());\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(Lb * rr.begin);\n        }\n\n        const val_t* radE = state.radE.data();\n        for (size_t dt = 0; dt < Lb; ++dt) {\n            const size_t t = t0 + dt;\n            for (size_t i = rows.begin; i < rows.end; ++i) {\n                val_t sumB = ZERO;\n                const val_t* kRow = &state.kij[(i - rows.begin) * N];\n                const int* tauRow = &state.tau[(i - rows.begin) * N];\n\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    if (i == j) continue;\n\n                    int tauij = tauRow[j];\n\n                    // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                    if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                    val_t kij = kRow[j];\n                    if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                    // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n                    size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n                    val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n                    if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                    // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                    sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n                }\n\n                // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n                val_t value = state.rho[i] * sumB + radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n                state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = value;\n                blockBuf[displs[g_rank] + dt * localN + (i - rows.begin)] = value;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Exchange this block's radiosity rows across all ranks\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL,\n                       blockBuf.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n            if (r == g_rank) continue;  // Own rows were written directly above\n            RowRange rr = partitionRows(N, r, g_size);\n            const size_t cnt = rr.count();\n            for (size_t dt = 0; dt < Lb; ++dt) {\n                const size_t t = t0 + dt;\n                const val_t* src = &blockBuf[static_cast<size_t>(displs[r]) + dt * cnt];\n                std::copy(src, src + cnt, &state.radB[state.idxTN(t, rr.begin)]);\n            }\n        }\n\n        for (size_t dt = 0; dt < Lb; ++dt) {\n            size_t t = t0 + dt;\n            if (g_rank == 0 && ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T)) {\n                printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, T);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    const RowRange rows = state.rows;\n\n    std::vector<val_t> localDist(rows.count(), ZERO);\n\n    for (size_t i = rows.begin; i < rows.end; ++i) {\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n                sum += pS * pB;\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        localDist[i - rows.begin] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n\n    // Gather distances from all ranks so every rank holds the full vector\n    std::vector<int> counts(g_size), displs(g_size);\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n        RowRange rr = partitionRows(N, r, g_size);\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(rr.count());\n        displs[r] = static_cast<int>(rr.begin);\n    }\n    MPI_Allgatherv(localDist.data(), static_cast<int>(localDist.size()), MPI_FLOAT,\n                   state.distances.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            ROOT_PRINTF(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            ROOT_PRINTF(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        ROOT_PRINTF(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        ROOT_PRINTF(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries); count across all ranks\n    unsigned long long localNonZeroKij = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.kij.size(); ++i) {\n        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) localNonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    unsigned long long nonZeroKij = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&localNonZeroKij, &nonZeroKij, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    const unsigned long long totalKij =\n        static_cast<unsigned long long>(state.numTriangles) * state.numTriangles;\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  Non-zero form factors: %llu/%llu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n                nonZeroKij, totalKij,\n                100.0f * static_cast<val_t>(nonZeroKij) / static_cast<val_t>(totalKij));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        ROOT_PRINTF(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Options:\\n\");\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            ROOT_PRINTF(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"===================================\\n\");\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", g_size);\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Initialize\n    SimulationState state;\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);\n\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Precomputation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto startPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeTimeDelays(state);\n    computeFormFactors(state);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto endPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto preDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endPre - startPre).count();\n\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Precomputation time: %ld ms\\n\", preDuration);\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Simulation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto startSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n
